fieldData.description: The first Radix meet-up in Vietnam will take place in Hanoi on the 2nd of April. This will be a great chance to meet like-minded Radix supporters and talk about crypto, DeFi, and Radix! If you would like to attend please also join the Vietnamese Telegram group: https://t.me/RadixVietnam
fieldData.location: I-House coffee shop - 131 P. Yên Hoa, Yen Hoa, Cau Giay, Ha Noi
fieldData.name: Community Meet Up - Hanoi, Vietnam
